<thought>We have a molecular weight of ~268.19, which matches the formula C18H20O2 (exact mass 268.146). The 13C NMR shows 12 aromatic carbons (six unique, duplicated) and 6 aliphatic carbons (three unique, duplicated), indicating a symmetric molecule with two identical aromatic halves attached to a central carbonyl/ether functionality. A common symmetric structure fitting C18H20O2 is 4,4'-dimethylbenzophenone (also named 4,4'-dimethyl diphenyl ketone). Its SMILES is 'CC1=CC=C(C=O)C=C1C2=CC=C(C)C=C2'. This matches the observed carbon count and symmetry.</thought>
<final_answer>CC1=CC=C(C=O)C=C1C2=CC=C(C)C=C2</final_answer>
